title: Crystal structure and nucleic acid binding activity of the conserved UPF0235 family protein PF1765 from Pyrococcus furiosus.
authors: Yadav, Beena; Gaikwad, Sujay S; Kumar, Ashwani; Gupta, Gagan D; Kumar, Amit; Makde, Ravindra D
one_liner_zh: 该文解析了古菌UPF0235蛋白PF1765的晶体结构并实验验证其核酸结合活性，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构与功能研究，且使用AlphaFold3建模，对本课题有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: The UPF0235 UniProt family proteins are conserved across archaea, bacteria, and eukaryotes; however, they remain functionally uncharacterized. Here, we report the high resolution (1.3 A) crystal structure of UPF0235 protein (PF1765, UniProt: Q8U052) from Pyrococcus furiosus. The structure exhibits a compact alpha+beta fold with a beta(4)-alpha-beta(2)-alpha topology, forming a pseudo beta-barrel comprising predominantly antiparallel six beta-strands encasing two alpha-helices. Structural comparisons via DALI revealed no significant similarity to known functional proteins, indicating PF1765's unique topology. Despite the low sequence identity (20-35 %), AlphaFold3 models of PF1765 homologs exhibit high structural conservation (RMSD <1.63 A) across all domains of life, suggesting strong evolutionary pressure to preserve its 3-D structure. The biophysical characterization of PF1765 confirms the monomeric nature and thermal stability up to 95  degrees C, consistent with its hyperthermophilic origin. In silico predictions of nucleic acid binding potential of PF1765 was substantiated by biochemical evidence using electrophoretic mobility shift assays and fluorescence polarization experiments. We demonstrated that PF1765 binds variably to dsDNA, ssDNA, and RNA, despite lacking canonical nucleic acid binding domains. Our study provides the first structural and functional characterization of a member of the UPF0235 protein family, revealing PF1765 as a thermostable, evolutionarily conserved, and structurally unique nucleic acid-binding protein.
abstract_zh: UPF0235 UniProt家族蛋白在古菌、细菌和真核生物中保守存在；然而，它们的功能尚未被表征。在此，我们报道了来自超嗜热古菌Pyrococcus furiosus的UPF0235蛋白（PF1765，UniProt: Q8U052）的高分辨率（1.3 Å）晶体结构。该结构呈现紧凑的alpha+beta折叠，具有beta(4)-alpha-beta(2)-alpha拓扑结构，形成一个伪beta桶，主要由六条反平行beta链包裹两条alpha螺旋组成。通过DALI进行的结构比较显示，与已知功能蛋白无显著相似性，表明PF1765具有独特的拓扑结构。尽管序列同一性较低（20-35%），PF1765同源物的AlphaFold3模型在所有生命域中表现出高度结构保守性（RMSD <1.63 Å），提示存在强烈的进化压力以维持其三维结构。PF1765的生物物理表征确认了其单体性质及高达95摄氏度的热稳定性，与其超嗜热起源一致。PF1765核酸结合潜力的计算机预测通过电泳迁移率变动分析和荧光偏振实验的生化证据得到证实。我们证明PF1765可变异地结合双链DNA、单链DNA和RNA，尽管缺乏典型的核酸结合结构域。我们的研究提供了UPF0235蛋白家族成员的首个结构和功能表征，揭示PF1765是一种热稳定、进化保守且结构独特的核酸结合蛋白。
